The candidate002 FREEZE, sole new adapter, fixture manifest, all 115 frozen payloads and 24 companions have their exact recorded lengths, modes and SHA256. Closed inventories contain no missing or extra file payloads.

Compared with the preserved candidate001 ZIP, 110 original payloads are unchanged. Only README, manifest and adapter changed; MOCK-PRELAUNCH and REVISION are added. All 47 independently decoded inert ELF mutations, 56 reviewed contexts, original crosswalk and COMMANDS remain unchanged.

C05 now invokes real _run_command and real _launch_check on changed inert temporary-file identity. A counted fake process boundary must remain zero. One stipulated preflight, one real launch check, no later launch guards, literal drift diagnostic, PROVEN_ZERO and complete frozen failure publications are asserted.

The full thawed returned schema/subjects/loader policy is compared to independent frozen context descriptors. Top-level, nested subject and nested loader immutability and exact six bound-read order remain checked.

F05 records and guards os.open, requires zero opens/zero bound reads/no returned policy, preserves the exact callback exception object, and requires the sequence to end at exactly the third subject checkpoint.

Raw callback identity, read-error wrapping, final close-error identity/no retry, and final identity drift use real data reads and descriptor ownership observations. The close-error probe closes its test resource once before raising, preserving the product fault without leaking a descriptor.

C06 retains the exact fake successful receipt for PID/process_group 12345 through real _run_command/_retain_outcome/on_started/_count_observed. Five C06 and three C05 complete publication payloads/descriptors independently hash correctly and bind the frozen plan; fake starts are clearly separate from actual target starts.

Old schema/default routes retain their exact prior errors and cannot invoke new checkpoints. L07/L08 authenticate and execute complete unchanged P16/P17 and P24/P25 corpora with exact method inventories. N34 and historical N57 remain external review obligations, never runtime passes or skips.

The exact 372-ID cohort, all eight modules and five generated-inventory sources are bound. SafeArchiveInstallation uses inert temporary archive controls, not operational installation. The retained driver child is solely inline Python environment transport, with no OntoKin/native readback.

The separately accepted runner requires this accepted FREEZE hash before command selection/Popen; verifies closed payloads, companions and inventory sources; creates fresh roots; preserves exact argv, source snapshots, raw logs, return codes and source-change observations.

FUTURE-SURFACE permits the next implementation phase documentary area. The current Director decision identifies required-images-p29 as new reconstruction, consistent with the adopted scope and preservation of original P27/P28 history. No placement exception or new user permission is required.
No product import/test execution, host profiling, native target start, installation, H0/H1, original-seven/full routine, remote write, or claim of missing P28 recovery occurred in this review.
